evidence.detail: Fixed skipped per-match Elo by changing '==' to '!=' in match.py:33; this was the bug identified in issue comments as '959d9c5'
adjust_elo() uses current DB Elo values — incremental approach that diverges from the full replay
Scheduled job replays ALL matches from scratch in chronological order, starting everyone at STARTING_ELO=1500; always overrides per-match values

triage.notes: The per-match bug (wrong == condition) was fixed in 35a9792a, reducing the magnitude of jumps. However, the two algorithms remain architecturally different — incremental vs. full replay — and will still diverge whenever matches arrive out of chronological order or after the nightly job runs. A real fix would require either removing per-match updates entirely and relying on the scheduled job, or making per-match updates do a replay from the affected match forward.
